title: DTN HBH: ztest matrix for S-flag/expiry parse + DTN routing path
description: Child of b7z9.8.2, after .2.2. tests/routing_dispatch: malformed HBH options (bad TLV length, unknown-type action bits, HBH not first, nonzero reserved in S-flag option), S-flag with valid/zero/garbage expiry, forward path with expiry present (hop-limit interplay - spec says S-F messages carry absolute expiry INSTEAD of relying on hop limit), DTN store decision using wire expiry vs caller field. Land with suite green.
